title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your makerspace assistant runs a 3-call request. The model is called three times, and the program sends the full history each time. Call 1's input is 1,000 tokens, the model's reply is 50 tokens, and a tool result of 300 tokens comes back. Which pieces are in call 2's input?

options.text: Only the 300-token tool result, since the model already read the rest
The 1,000-token input, the 50-token reply and the 300-token tool result
The 1,000-token input and the 300-token tool result, but not the reply
Only a short summary the model wrote itself while it waited for the tool

items.stem: In a 3-call run, call 1's input is 1,000 tokens. After call 1 the model writes 50 tokens and a 300-token tool result comes back; that makes call 2's input. Call 2 then writes 40 tokens and a 200-token tool result comes back. Call 3 sends the whole history again. How many input tokens does call 3 have?
The assistant must answer from 40 manuals totaling 2 million tokens, and each student asks about one machine. Which design keeps cost per request lowest while still finding the right page?

options.text: Put all 40 manuals in the first call and rely on the large window
Summarize all 40 manuals into one page and never look at the originals
Give a search tool that returns the best few chunks for each question
Ask the student to paste in the manual pages that they think matter

items.stem: A student, Jonas, finishes a session with the assistant. The next day he starts a new session and the assistant does not know his preferred booking times. In one sentence, why not, and what must the program do for the assistant to know them?
The assistant's notes say "Jonas is trained on the 3D printer", written two months ago. Training can expire. Jonas asks to book the printer today. What should the assistant do?

options.text: Trust the note, since the assistant wrote it and it was true then
Book the slot and delete the note so that it can't mislead anyone
Ask Jonas whether his training is still valid and accept his answer
Look up his status in the training database, because it can change
